audience: teams who plan and track work in ClickUp

useCases.title: Search tasks across the workspace
useCases.text: The AI searches the tasks of a whole workspace, optionally within chosen spaces, folders or lists, and lists what it finds. You get the tasks you need in one call.

useCases.title: Browse a list and read its tasks
useCases.text: From a space, the AI lists folders and lists, then reads the tasks of a list. You see what is in one list.

useCases.title: Read the discussion on a task or list
useCases.text: The AI reads the comments on a task or on a list and sums up what was said and decided.

useCases.title: Create a task in a list
useCases.text: The AI creates a new task with a name in the list you choose, so a request from a chat or an email becomes a task.

useCases.title: Update a task or add a comment
useCases.text: The AI changes fields on an existing task, and can add a comment to it. Only the fields you name are changed.
